import urllib.request, json
try:
    r = urllib.request.urlopen('http://127.0.0.1:8765/api/status', timeout=5)
    body = r.read().decode('utf-8', 'replace')
    print('HTTP', r.status, 'bytes', len(body))
    print(body[:4000])
except Exception as e:
    print('ERR', repr(e))
